Privacy

How your details are handled.

Updated 19 October 2026 · Website preview

Project enquiries

The project form prepares a brief in your browser. This preview does not submit your details to a Tivoro enquiry database. Opening an email draft does not send it: you choose whether to send through your email application. Copying the brief places it on your device’s clipboard.

Email and WhatsApp

If you email or message Tivoro, the details you choose to share are used to understand and respond to your enquiry. Your email or messaging provider processes communications under its own terms and privacy practices.

Site services

Hosting services process connection information needed to deliver the website. Fonts are supplied through Google Fonts. Client website links lead to independent sites with their own policies.

Measurement and browser storage

This preview does not load a third-party marketing or analytics tracker. A temporary browser session value supports page arrival animations; it does not contain your project form details. Project briefs are not saved in browser storage by this website.

Questions and requests

For questions about details you have shared with Tivoro, contact tivorosupport@gmail.com. We will discuss your request and any information needed to respond.
